tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Watch companies. `action`='start' (the default) starts watching one: at most one alert a day, listing what changed with its sources; `entity_id` is the one find_company returns (or a Swiss UID), and `layers` optionally narrows it to a comma-separated list of register, sanctions, regulator (blank wat

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.description: Stop watching one company, given by its `entity_id` (or a Swiss UID): no further alerts for it. A company watched through a book (a Mandates firm's or a household's companies) goes on alerting, and the answer says so. A stopped watch can be started again.
